posts.body:
What is CustomLogo_MZ?
It is an updated version of the classic RPG Maker MV plugin Customlogo.js. It has been updated to RPG Maker MZ with permission from the company. I tried to keep it close to the original. I've updated the icons for it as well in RPG Maker standard resolution (816 * 624) and HD (1920 * 1080). You can also use your own images as well. It supports three images natively.
Features
Supports 3 custom images
Optional skipping
Time selection
Centering controls

How to use
Spoiler
If you're familiar with RPG Maker MV, the process is identical.
Copy customlogo_MZ.js to your project's js/plugins folder.
Copy the logos to the your project's img/system folder.
Open the plugin manager (F10 key).
Double click the empty slot to bring up the selection.
Select CustomLogo_MZ.js.
This will reveal the plugin parameters.
Select your desired image from Logo 1 Image Name.
You can choose any other modifiers as you wish. To test, remember to turn off the setting to "Skip Title Screen" in the RPG Maker Game menu.
